entries.zh: 畏惧（怕遭凶咎、恶果）；亦即敬畏——敬而生畏（temer con respeto）
entries.en: to fear ill success or misfortune; to fear with reverence, to stand in awe
to fear with respect, to revere
to dread, to fear greatly (惮 dàn)
entries.notes: R 栏“ty. cau le chien le [残]”污损连读难辨（T99），主释据 L“temer mucho”与 M“惮”互证。

entries.en: to be in fear and confusion, panic-stricken (temer mucho)
entries.notes: R 栏“hoyng giony nosabe lofserva”混有西语短语且两处调号污损（T99），仅 M“惶”可确证主义。

entries.en: to repent, to reform (悛 quān)
entries.notes: M“悛”与 R“chun”互证为悔改义，与 L“temer no será bueno”（怕）义不合，四栏无法贯通。

entries.en: to fear, to be afraid and startled
to fear and submit, to be overawed
to fear and scruple, to stand in awe
to be terrified, horrified
alarmed, panic-stricken
startled, stunned with fear

entries.zh: 恐怕——惧怕；亦作推度语，犹言“只怕、怕是”
entries.en: to fear; (modal) I am afraid, probably
fear, dread
fear and awe, dread

entries.zh: 颤抖、发抖——因惧而身慄（交慄）
entries.en: to tremble, to shudder with fear

entries.zh: 畏惧（疑 R 栏“pa puy”当为“怕怖”）
entries.en: to fear, dread (probable reading 怕怖 “fear”)
entries.notes: L“temer do noay & temer”残乱、M“有屁”义不通，仅 R“pa puy”疑合“怕怖”，四栏互证失败。

entries.zh: 怕惹事——怕招惹是非（畏惹事）
entries.en: to be afraid of provoking trouble or causing a stir
entries.notes: L“temer el meserpeñalgo [残]”词头残损难辨，主释据 M“畏惹事”与 R“vy xia su”。

entries.zh: 惊动——使惊惶骚动；惊扰不安（西语 alborotarse＝自相惊扰）
entries.en: to alarm, to be thrown into commotion (alborotarse)
entries.notes: 第二调号污损（T99），主释据 M“驚動”与 L“alborotarce”相合。

entries.zh: 忌惮——有所畏忌而不敢放肆
entries.en: to dread and scruple, to stand in awe of (忌惮)
entries.notes: L“temer auer por cara”难以确解，释义主要依 M“忌惮”与 R“gui tan”互证。

entries.en: to tremble, to shudder with fear (戰慄)
to quake with terror (classical 觳觫: to shudder, as an ox led to slaughter)
entries.notes: L“temer como al lioquie: en castigar [残]”残损难辨（T99），主释据 M“觳觫”，R“han le”对音亦未尽合。
